verdict.rationale: ELSTER is an online tax-filing service with a third-party software channel, so issuing scoped credentials for an agent is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows a single registration certificate per user or organisation (elster-supp-1, elster-docs-16), which is not scoped. It also shows adjacent human delegation features: powers of attorney filed with the tax office (elster-docs-4) and mailbox delegates who can view messages (elster-docs-17). None of these is a documented way to issue least-privilege API credentials for an agent, so they earn no credit.
